gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.kort.5: To Patguh by the jelly fields
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.5: Patguh wants to go jellyfishing! Walk to Patguh, who waits with the nets by the jelly fields at the edge of town.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.5_b: Catch crumb jellies with your net: tap a glowing jelly gently. Eight for Patguh!
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.6: Mrs. Puffguh's boating school is on the west side of town, by the pylon course. Spongeguh is taking his exam again, and you are going to help him.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.6_b: Steer the grease boat past all the pylons, over the little bridge and back to the finish. Take it easy: Spongeguh screams enough for two.
